process.interpretation: This receipt reconciles existing repository contracts and gates future leaves; it does not replace or reinterpret the controller-reviewed operating model or decisions.

rationale: The historical identity and Power Platform read-connector contract paths are byte-identical at the historical milestone commit and the current base, so they are reusable without ownership competition.

The later integration-profile, Gateway, Policy, Admission, Verification Fabric, receipt, update tuple, migration, compatibility, revocation, Accepted and LKG contracts remain authoritative in their existing paths and are consumed by reference only.
A new package prefix is the only selected extension boundary. Shared contract files are not forked or edited by PSAI #32.

The current Gateway catalogue is local-synthetic and does not admit Power Platform actions. The current Power Platform connector has no proposal, approval, execution or cancellation operations. Real import and effect leaves therefore remain blocked rather than inheriting authority from contract or capability bytes.

nonCompetingRules: Do not edit the completed Azure identity or Power Platform read-connector v1 files.
Do not edit Gateway, Policy, Admission, Approval, Verification Fabric, update, migration, Accepted or LKG shared contracts from this boundary.
Consume shared exports by exact version and digest; an incompatible or missing export blocks the leaf.
Any required shared change is a separately owned additive version or barrel-export PR, never an in-place PSAI #32 fork.

sharedIntegrationPoints.allowedFutureChange: Add only the power-platform-read-only:test script and include it in the repository gate.
Add exact public-safe boundary files after leakage review.
Update only the exact manifest count binding required by the added manifest entries.
Refresh tracked source checksums only through the repository integrity workflow.
Add one unambiguous owner node with exact input digests and owned tests.

rules: Accept JSON null, booleans, strings, finite numbers, dense arrays and plain data objects only.

Reject negative zero, unsafe integral numbers, non-finite numbers, undefined, sparse or augmented arrays, accessors, proxies, cycles, non-string own keys, non-enumerable data properties, non-plain prototypes and dangerous keys __proto__, prototype and constructor before hashing.
Preserve array order and sort object keys with the repository canonicalJson lexical key order.
Encode the canonical JSON string as UTF-8 and compute SHA-256 lowercase hexadecimal.
For a self-digested record, remove exactly the declared digest field and no other field before canonicalization.
A content digest is not a signature, approval, activation, execution lease or authority.

openApi.submitRequestSemantics: The body refers to a previously stored immutable Gateway request by digest. It cannot carry a URL, HTTP method, tenant, identity, credential, query text, field selector, provider body or authority. The Gateway must load and independently authorize the referenced request.

failClosedCases.case: accepted response without authoritative readback and receipt

receiptAndReadbackBinding.tamperEvidence: receiptDigest binds the exact closed receipt core; the Verification Fabric evidence bundle and Accepted/LKG records bind receipt and readback digests from an independent trusted context.

forbiddenFieldsAndChannels: url except an allowlisted public evidence reference

acceptedLkgAndRollback.acceptedAdvance: Only the exact readback-receipted tuple becomes Accepted; transport acceptance, import acceptance or execution return alone cannot advance it.
acceptedLkgAndRollback.lkgAdvance: The previously verified Accepted full tuple remains LKG until the new Accepted tuple has independently verified health and public-safe evidence. No partial-axis fallback is allowed.
acceptedLkgAndRollback.rollbackAuthorization: A rollback decision never executes rollback. A fresh explicit rollback-authority record bound to environment, operation, LKG tuple digest, policy generation, expiry, revocation observation and single-use replay key is required at use time.

pathOwnership.futureRule: Reuse exact v1 bytes or add a separately owned versioned successor; no in-place widening.
Reference the POWER_APPS_READ_ONLY profile by exact profile digest; incompatible changes require a successor schema.
No Power Platform action is admitted by v1. A compatible action must be separately reviewed and versioned by the shared owner.
Only the Verification Fabric owner may add one unambiguous node and exact digests for the selected boundary.
Consume pure contracts by exact digest. Their checked metadata does not execute migration, switch, rollback or cleanup.
The migration checkpoint direct module is not currently barrel-exported; a separately owned export change is required if package-level consumption needs it.
Touch only after a fresh-base repository implementation authorization; remain repository-only and inactive until later state transitions authorize external mutation.
Immutable containing-commit evidence; correction requires a new receipt rather than silent rewrite after publication.

receiptBinding.digestAlgorithm: SHA-256 over canonical receipt bytes with the top-level receiptDigest field omitted
receiptBinding.determinism: No run clock, random identifier, credential, tenant identifier or private workspace path is included. Repository and public-source observations are pinned by SHA, version, digest and source-updated timestamp.
receiptBinding.tamperResponse: Any digest mismatch denies use of this receipt. A corrected decision requires a new containing commit and receipt, not an in-place authority inference.
